disclaimer: Fictional stylized adult character design. Values are proposed and should not be described as clinical measurements, health advice, or approved artwork. Stylized 5.7-head proportions are not literal human anthropometric anatomy.

character.visualGoal: youthful-looking, mischievous, frail and very lean; clothed visual-novel sprite

bodyComposition.note: BMI 16.89 is below adult 18.5 threshold, clinically underweight, but actual fat percent cannot be calculated from BMI or appearance; 18.5% is purely an artist's fictional assumption.

faceLandmarksProposed.coordinateSystem: front portrait; head top y=0, chin y=1; x=0 left face edge, x=1 right edge; not measured from approved art

skinDesign.tone: pale muted warm-neutral skin, not chalk white
skinDesign.surface: fine smooth anime skin, subtle under-eye dullness, slight dryness at elbows and finger joints, no airbrushed plastic skin
skinDesign.visibleFreckles: 2-4 tiny low-contrast light brown specks around nose bridge and character's left cheek; not randomized across frames
skinDesign.visibleMoles: one fixed tiny mole on character's right outer forearm, 1mm design cue; no additional new moles unless approved
skinDesign.temporaryMarks: faint knee discoloration only as optional costume/scene state, not a permanent birthmark
skinDesign.bodyHair: extremely fine near-invisible vellus hair on exposed forearms and lower legs, drawn only if close-up artwork supports it
skinDesign.intimateDetails: excluded from clothed youthful-looking character sprite; not needed for identity, anatomy rig, or prompt

silhouette.build: extremely narrow delicate adult frame, sparse subcutaneous fullness, slight visible clavicles, subtle elbow/wrist and knee bony landmarks, slender straight thighs and thin calves; avoid caricatured protruding ribs or pathologizing visual language
silhouette.face: soft short heart-shaped youthful face, rounded cheeks, small chin and nose, mischievous half-lidded upward cat eyes
silhouette.hair: dusty berry pink asymmetrical fluffy twin tails, one tied slightly higher; outward-flipped ends, one prominent ahoge, loose flyaways; fixed left/right placement
silhouette.pose: mostly frontal dialogue idle, character's left hand lightly on waist, character's right hand raised a little near chest with one playful extended index finger, elbow close to body, slight head tilt, subtle shoulder asymmetry, same ground baseline

production.camera: eye-level full-body, minimal perspective, slight head tilt only
production.note: Do not generate multiple versions by pure prompt if precise dimensional constancy is required; use approved character master, skeleton/pose and reference-driven rendering.
